scope: 403 Base addresses from the incident ownership inventories, legacy staging records and current Base artifacts. This is not an exhaustive all-chain deployment or asset scan.

balanceScope.limitations: No exhaustive ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 indexer inventory; no assertion that zero sampled balances proves absence of every asset, allowance, claim or future incoming payment.

authorityLimitations: Registry membership and current no-argument dependency getters only. Does not exhaust per-deposit hooks/guardians/gating, all lifecycle snapshots, every custom role, token allowances, external client routing or cross-chain authority.
readSemantics: All reads pinned to the Base block. Balance and registry calls succeeded for all 403 addresses. Failed owner() reads are recorded, never treated as zero owner or absence of authority.
